name: Playboys 13
description: The Playboys 13 (PBS13) is a predominantly Mexican-American Sureño street gang founded in the mid-1950s as the 'Southern Califas Latin Playboys Car Club' at Pico Boulevard and Fedora Street in the Pico-Union area of Los Angeles. Mexican Mafia-affiliated. Has spread to Orange County and other parts of Southern California including Bell Gardens, South Gate, and Burbank. Multiple factions: Westside (original, Pico/Fedora area), Eastside (South Central, Vernon Ave to Slauson Ave), and Southside (Bell Gardens/South Gate). Each clique operates with significant autonomy. Known for the Playboy bunny tattoo and graffiti symbol (PBS around the head). Rivals with 18th Street, Florencia 13, 38th Street, and most other Sureño gangs despite shared La Eme affiliation.
